# @ndigo/flags

Feature flags for Ndigo — the FlagEvaluator SPI (typed, async, never-throw), the property-backed local provider, and the @whenFeature gate metadata

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `likeFlagEvaluator` — Structural type guard for FlagEvaluator — used where an entry or option is resolved by shape instead of the "context-tokens".FLAG_EVALUATOR token.
- `validateFlagKey` — Validates a flag key — used at decoration time (fail loud at definition) and by providers at evaluation time.
- `FlagErrorCode` *(type)* — Machine-readable error classification for abnormal evaluations (OpenFeature error-code vocabulary).
- `FlagEvaluation` *(type)* — The outcome of FlagEvaluator.evaluate.
- `FlagEvaluationContext` *(type)* — The runtime context a flag evaluation may use for targeting.
- `FlagEvaluationReason` *(type)* — Why a flag resolved the way it did — the OpenFeature reason vocabulary (best-effort metadata: a provider may only supply a subset, and an unrecognized provider…
- `FlagEvaluator` *(type)* — Feature-flag backend contract. Implementations MUST be safe for concurrent use and MUST NOT throw from `evaluate` — a broken backend degrades to the supplied d…
- `FlagValue` *(type)* — A flag value: boolean, number, string, or a JSON-like structure.
- `PropertyFlagProvider` — The local, zero-config flag provider: `feature.<flag>` properties drive evaluations, read live on every call.
- `stableBucket` — Maps a flag name and targeting key to a stable bucket in `[0, 1)` by hashing them together (FNV-1a), so percentage rollouts are deterministic per target and in…
- `FlagPropertyReader` *(type)* — The property reader the provider evaluates against. The environment satisfies this shape structurally (`getProperty(key)`), so the leaf package never depends o…
- `PropertyFlagProviderOptions` *(type)* — Options for PropertyFlagProvider.
- `getWhenFeature` — Reads the feature gate recorded by `@whenFeature`.
- `whenFeature` — Marks a class or method as gated on a feature flag: the handler is only reachable while the flag evaluates truthy.
- `WHEN_FEATURE_KEY` — Metadata key for `@whenFeature` — class-level under `WHEN_FEATURE_KEY`, method-level under `${WHEN_FEATURE_KEY}:<methodName>` (method wins).
- `FLAG_EVALUATOR` — The application's flag evaluator entry (default: `PropertyFlagProvider` over the environment, registered by `NodeAutoConfiguration`). Apps override the entry w…
